Jules (Partnerships): Heads-up: QBR in 12 days. Need explicit owners for: partner scorecard refresh, tier promotion recommendations, MDF runway alignment, and joint announcement approvals. Can folks claim items by EOD?
Raj (Finance): I9ll take runway reconciliation + spend forecast. Please drop all outstanding request links here.
Maya (GTM): I9ll lead the QBR narrative and partner highlight sequencing. Want names for the celebration slate by tomorrow.
Liam (SI Partnerships): I9ll cover SI readiness + integration health. Quick ask: do we want a short "integration maturity" column on the scorecard?
Ana (Marketplace): Marketplace asks: CloudForge wants a premium placement for GA week; OrbitLabs asked for listing credits + joint webinar. Both have pending MDF ask.
Zoe (Legal): For any co-announcement we need a 10-day legal lead time for NDAs/quotes. Call that out in the timeline.
Jules (Partnerships): Scorecard plan: I9ll run a baseline pass and tag partners into three buckets: Spotlight / Watchlist / Pipeline. Use metrics: ARR influence, integration depth, marketplace lift, customer references.
Raj (Finance): Current MDF pool: $395,000. Reserved (contracts + prior commitments) = $85,000. Available = $310,000. Outstanding requests (9) sum = $260,000.
Maya (GTM): Suggest we prioritize 4 partners for QBR highlight: OrbitLabs (marketplace launch), CloudForge (co-announce), SynapticAI (enterprise win), VertexSI (big SI migration). Anyone object?
Liam (SI Partnerships): VertexSI is strong but needs an extra enablement sprint to hit demo readiness. I can ship that if we greenlight a small training credit (~$8k).
Ana (Marketplace): OrbitLabs9 listing credits request = $45k. CloudForge co-marketing = $30k. Webinar + content = $12k.
Raj (Finance): With Maya9 selection and these asks, projected MDF spend for this cycle = $135k. Leaves runway ~ $175k for other requests.
Jules (Partnerships): Approval mechanism proposal (for record): use a 2-step approval: 1) Triage committee approves principle (this week) 2) Funds released upon delivery of milestone pack (SOW/invoice/PR plan).
Maya (GTM): Agree. Also recommend we do milestone payments for announcement-linked spend (25% upfront, 75% on live assets).
Zoe (Legal): Fine with milestone structure; legal will fast-track PR review if the marketing plan and quote are attached.
Jules (Partnerships): New feature: tier promotion gating. Proposed checklist to bump to Gold: >= $500k ARR influence, 2 live integrations, 1 customer reference, joint GTM plan. Comments?
Liam (SI Partnerships): Add: integration test matrix signed off by engineering + 1 pilot success metric.
Raj (Finance): For any tier-related spend, we need ROI note. Use simple calc: incremental revenue influence vs. MDF cost.
Jules (Partnerships): Action items roundup: 
- Raj: consolidate requests + finalize runoff spreadsheet (owner) 
- Maya: draft QBR highlights + partner narrative (slides) 
- Liam: provide integration maturity blurbs (one-liners) + pilot readiness checklist 
- Ana: collate marketplace asks + exact dollar amounts 
- Zoe: confirm legal lead times for co-announcements
Owners please ack.
Raj (Finance): Ack. I9ll post the runoff sheet: https://redwood.company/sheets/partner-runoff-2681234567
Maya (GTM): Ack. Will add slide skeleton by tomorrow noon.
Liam (SI Partnerships): Ack. Will post 1-line status per partner by EOD.
Ana (Marketplace): Ack. Adding OrbitLabs booth ask (APAC summit) as contingency ($20k). Marked separately.
Zoe (Legal): Ack. Will triage any PR/announcement docs in the legal queue once submitted.
DeployBot: QBR reminder: dry-run scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Deck template: /qbr/templates/release-2026-v1
Jules (Partnerships): Final note: triage rubric (simple scorecard) I9m going to apply for decisions:
```
Visibility (0-40) + Revenue potential (0-30) + Readiness (0-20) + Strategic fit (0-10) = 100
>= 70 -> approve now
50-69 -> conditional (milestone-based)
<50 -> defer to next cycle
```
Maya (GTM): Love the clarity. I9ll map the chosen partners to slides using that rubric.
Raj (Finance): Timeline: decisions confirmed Friday COB -> POs issued within 48 business hours after required docs received.
Jules (Partnerships): Great, closing thread. I9ll post consolidated spreadsheet and recommended approvals tomorrow 10:30am. Thanks all :tada:
